sloka: गात्र संवाहनैः चैव श्रम अपनयनैः तथा ।शक्रः सर्वेषु कालेषु दितिम् परिचचार ह ॥१-४६-११॥
transliteration: gātra saṁvāhanaiḥ caiva śrama apanayanaiḥ tathā ।śakraḥ sarveṣu kāleṣu ditim paricacāra ha ॥1-46-11॥

translations.english: Indra attended on Diti, stroking her limbs gently from time to time to help her regain their suppleness and alleviate her fatigue.
